name: Politics And Religion
overview: Scripture reveals that God sovereignly governs the affairs of nations and rulers, establishing and removing leaders according to His divine will to fulfill His purposes (Daniel 2:21; 4:17). A nation is truly blessed when it acknowledges the LORD as its God and lives under His guidance (Psalms 33:12). Believers are called to pursue justice, mercy, and humility before God (Micah 6:8) while prioritizing His kingdom above earthly allegiances, recognizing that one cannot serve both God and worldly powers (Matthew 6:24, 6:33). This teaches that political engagement must be grounded in faithful obedience to God’s righteousness rather than divided loyalties.
